title: 声音是怎么跑过来的
subtitle: 空气在轻轻地推
character: wearing a striped blue t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, bold flat graphic art with thick hand-inked black outlines and slightly grainy flat fills in teal, coral and cream, simple chunky shapes, the illustration covers the entire image area

pages.zh:
妈妈在厨房叫我的名字，
我在客厅也听见了。
中间隔着一堵墙，
声音是怎么跑过来的呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands in a living room turning his head toward a doorway, one hand cupped behind his ear, listening.

pages.zh:
先摸摸自己的喉咙，
再说一声「啊——」。
是不是麻麻的、抖抖的？
那是声带在快速地「振动」。
声音，就是从振动来的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple side view of a throat on a cream background with two short vibrating lines drawn inside it and small curved motion marks beside them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鼓也是一样。
敲一下鼓面，
鼓皮上上下下地抖，
抖得越厉害，
声音就越大。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one round drum seen from the side on a cream background, its skin drawn with a slight curve and three short motion lines above and below it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鼓面一抖，
就把旁边的空气推了一下。
空气一挤一松，
把这个推的动作
一层一层传出去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one drum at the left of a cream background with a series of curved arcs spreading to the right, each arc a little further apart than the last. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以声音不是飞过来的，
是空气一个推一个
传过来的。
就像排队的人
一个轻轻推一个。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: a row of eight round dots across a cream background, the left ones squeezed close together and the right ones spread apart, with one arrow above showing the direction of travel. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
推得快，声音就高；
推得慢，声音就低。
小鸟叫是高高的，
大鼓响是低低的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two wavy lines across a cream background: the upper one with many tight waves, the lower one with few wide waves. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
声音在空气里跑得挺快，
一秒钟能跑三百多米。
可是比起光，
它慢多了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one straight arrow on a cream background labelled only by its length, short, and above it a much longer arrow, both pointing right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以打雷的时候，
我们先看见闪电，
过一会儿才听见雷声。
数一数中间隔了几秒，
就知道雷有多远。
pages.scene: A simple scene on a cream background: one jagged lightning bolt in a dark cloud at the top, and below it a house with curved sound arcs arriving later. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
声音也能在水里跑，
而且跑得更快。
鲸鱼就是靠声音说话的，
它们的歌声
能传出好几十公里。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one whale shape at the left of a teal background with curved sound arcs spreading to the right through the water. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
在没有空气的地方，
声音就跑不动了。
太空里静悄悄的，
就算飞船在旁边，
也听不见一点声音。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one small spaceship on a plain dark background with no arcs or lines around it at all, everything else empty. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
耳朵里有一张小小的膜，
叫耳膜。
空气推过来，
耳膜跟着抖，
我们就听见了声音。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple cross-section of an ear on a cream background with a small round membrane inside it and three curved arcs arriving from the left. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我拿两个纸杯和一根线，
做了一个土电话。
我在这头说话，
妹妹在那头真的听见了——
声音顺着线跑了过去。
pages.scene: The little boy holds a paper cup to his mouth with a taut string running from it across the room, laughing, another paper cup at the far end of the string.
